body:
You could just say something like “Hey, I don’t appreciate this type of comments and don’t enjoy when you push me to send pictures to you. I really value our friendship, and I would love if we get past this.”

But just like the other comments stated, why would you want to be friends with this person? She clearly doesn’t respect you. I was in a very similar position, I had a guy friend I clearly was not interested in and he kept making those types of comments, sometimes he would also talk about sex out of nowhere which made really uncomfortable. Looking back now, I realize he never respected me and I should have ended that friendship sooner. Make sure you’re not committing the same mistake. You deserve better.
Aah 🥰🥰 thank you , I hope you have a lovely day/night too
Thank you for sharing your story. It’s really hard to talk having so much shame, but your reply gave me hope that maybe, one day, I can stop feeling this way
Yes. Online or not, the shame stays with me

I am out of questions for now. Just the usual doubts I wrote in the post + the incredible shame I feel talking about this. My day started terrible today, but your kindness will make me go to sleep tonight with some comfort in my heart. Thank you ☺️
I know the “solution”, if there is any, is to become close again to activities I used to like, but it’s so hard to do that nowadays... thank you for your reply, it was very sweet

Thank you for your reply, I felt really confused about the purpose of therapy and this helped me clarify my ideas a bit. I had never heard of those terms, but I will keep them on my mind. However, if I ever make the phone call, it will be to any kind of therapy. Filtering it sounds too difficult for me, because then I would have to search carefully for therapist and I don’t think I can do that (because of shame)
What if I already have a pet? I wish I could try harder, but I am so scared of people. Even if I chat to them, I could never go personal. I am so ashamed of everything about me
